item.title: The Criteria Behind My Decision to Move: Children, Justice and the Economy
item.description:
This post is part of the “Turkey or Germany?” series. It is not a contest of better or worse; it is about two different cultures and what to expect. Series intro: Before you start comparing

In the series intro I said that everyone should rank their own criteria before changing countries. Here are mine.

1. A better future for my children
#

For me, the top priority was being able to give my children a better future. I believe I can do that better in Germany.
